headline: Zelensky demands concrete agenda for upcoming 4-party peace talks
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky urged that the upcoming four-party peace talks involving Ukraine, Europe, Russia, and the US deliver concrete results based on defined goals.
why: Four-party diplomatic negotiations aim to establish terms for ending conflict in Eastern Europe.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Formal negotiations set framework conditions for geopolitical stability.
